value.a: THE HOST IS NOT HEX. `hex` does not resolve, is not in /etc/hosts, and is not on the ARP table — the M1 remains a plan. What exists is ollama on THIS box. That is fine and it is the point of the seam: build and prove against localhost now, and Hex later becomes a HOST SWAP behind the same seam. The librarian therefore does NOT wait on acquiring or wiring an M1, which is a materially different dependency picture from the one held-librarian assumed.

EMBEDDINGS ARE A DIFFERENT CALL SHAPE AND ARE NOT IN SCOPE HERE. inference_domain does completion-shaped caching; nomic-embed-text is an embedding endpoint. Both live on the same host, but wiring the completion resolver does not give the system embeddings, and pretending otherwise would repeat the done-but-not-connected defect this node exists to close. Whether Cairn wants a pretrained embedder AT ALL is Akien's open call — his objection stands ('every call is an inference call', so the curve never bends), with the word graph as the real answer and an off-the-shelf embedder at most a bootstrap that must carry a written exit condition.

THE OLDER EMBEDDINGS ENDPOINT CANNOT BE METERED. /api/embeddings returns ONLY the vector — no prompt_eval_count, no eval_count. Measured 2026-07-26, and it changed the build: resolving through it would have produced a working resolver whose every cost was 0, and yield_report — the instrument for the whole Telos 1 claim — would have reported a flawlessly consistent 0-spent/0-avoided. The shape right, the content hollow, and nothing red (Law 8). host.py uses /api/embed and RAISES HostUnmetered rather than defaulting a missing counter to 0: an unmetered answer is not cheaper than no answer, it is a lie about the thesis.

A FALSIFIER MADE MACHINE-CHECKABLE. Charter edge (c) carries a falsifier for T1.4 without evaluating it. A time horizon on a temperature-0 completion is theatre — nothing rots as the clock moves — so horizon is '' and the falsifier is 'model_digest(<model>) == <sha>', answerable by one /api/tags read. The edge stays open, but closing it is now a comparison rather than a design problem. Sampling is pinned to temperature 0 for the same reason: caching a nondeterministic call silently changes what the cache MEANS.

THE FIRST LIVE ROW CAUGHT WHAT 16 GREEN TEETH DID NOT. The run was green and the row it wrote said 'model_digest(nomic-embed-text) == <unread at resolve time>': the host tags the model 'nomic-embed-text:latest', the caller names it 'nomic-embed-text', and the dict lookup missed. So the falsifier degraded silently for the MOST COMMON way to name a model. Visible only by reading the record the run actually wrote (Law 3 — the proof attested the shape, only the live row showed the content was empty). Fixed, and the fixture now carries the ':latest' the host really reports, because a tidied fixture would have kept the proof green through the bug.

SOLE-PATH IS NOW RE-CHECKED, AND THE CHECK TESTS CAPABILITY NOT MENTION. Charter edge (b) said 'sole by construction' — a claim about the present that nothing re-ran. A tooth now scans the tree on every proof run. Written as a grep for ':11434' it flagged base/needs.py, where the string sits in a docstring, an error-message example and a test fixture: prose ABOUT a measurement, unable to open a socket. A check that cannot tell a door from a description of one gets trained away by its own noise — and would still miss a module that reads the endpoint from config. So it asks which modules can DIAL: outbound imports by full dotted name. Exactly one does. web_server/daemon.py imports http.server, which LISTENS and cannot reach anything — that distinction is the tooth's, not an exemption.
